tools.name: quarterwise_get_account
tools.description: Show which Quarterwise account the key belongs to, its plan (free, pro, expat, firm) and what the API can do. HMRC submission is always false: filing is done in the app. API: GET /api/v1/me.

tools.name: quarterwise_list_sources
tools.description: List the income sources on the account: UK properties, overseas properties and self-employment businesses, with id, type, share percent, role (owner or sharer) and transaction count. The id is the input of the transaction tools. API: GET /api/v1/sources.

tools.name: quarterwise_list_categories
tools.description: List the valid income and expense category keys (HMRC field names) per source type. Keys differ by type, so check them before adding transactions. API: GET /api/v1/categories.

tools.name: quarterwise_list_transactions
tools.description: List income and expense entries of one property or business, optionally in a date range. Amounts are in pence. Returns nextCursor: pass it as cursor to get the next page. API: GET /api/v1/sources/{id}/transactions.

tools.name: quarterwise_add_transactions
tools.description: WRITE: add 1 to 100 income or expense entries to a property or business ledger. Each entry needs a unique externalRef: re-posting the same ref adds nothing, so a retry is safe. Entries without a category go to the review queue in the app. Never submits anything to HMRC. API: POST /api/v1/sources/{id
